requirements.proposition_to_establish: Records for prescribed goods that have been rejected and/or failed export inspection are retained for at least 2 years, including records of blending, treatments and re-presentation of goods.
requirements.criterion_quote: At least 2 years of records for prescribed goods that have been rejected and/or failed export inspection are retained; including but not limited to records of blending, treatments and re-presentation of goods.
